mapper.select: SELECT ud.user_id AS userId, u.username AS username, u.nickname AS nickname, u.employee_no AS employeeNo, u.status AS userStatus, ud.is_primary AS isPrimary, ud.status AS relationStatus, ud.position AS position, ud.join_time AS joinTime FROM user_dept ud INNER JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = ud.user_id AND u.is_deleted = 0 WHERE ud.dept_id = #{deptId} AND ud.status IN (1, 2) ORDER BY ud.is_primary DESC, ud.join_time DESC, u.username

SELECT p.id AS id, p.post_code AS postCode, p.post_name AS postName, p.status AS status, p.order_num AS orderNum FROM sys_post p WHERE p.dept_id = #{deptId} AND p.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY p.order_num, p.post_code

SELECT r.role_code AS roleCode, r.role_name AS roleName, r.status AS status, r.role_type AS roleType, gt.grant_time AS grantTime FROM grant_table gt INNER JOIN sys_role r ON r.role_code = gt.role_code WHERE gt.subject_type = 'DEPT' AND gt.subject_id = #{deptId} ORDER BY r.role_code
